brand.name: Calvo
brand.tagline: AI voice agents, built for how your business actually runs.
brand.shortDescription: Calvo builds custom-trained AI calling agents for businesses that can't afford to miss a call.
brand.longDescription: Calvo provides AI-powered voice agents that answer, qualify, and route calls for businesses — trained specifically on how each business actually operates, not a generic script. Every agent is built around the client's real workflows, tone, and edge cases.

positioning.core: vertical-neutral, category-level: AI calling infrastructure for any business
positioning.proofLayer: vertical-specific case studies and landing pages carry the specialized language
positioning.doNotDo: do not bake a single industry's visual or verbal identity into the core brand

primary.name: CPA & Accounting Firms
painPoints: Missed calls during tax season peak volume
Front desk staff overwhelmed with routine scheduling/status calls
Client trust requires professional, accurate call handling — no room for a bad AI experience

proofPoint.metric: missed call rate reduced from 32% to 5%

secondary.name: Restaurants
painPoints: Missed reservation calls during dinner rush
Staff can't answer phone and serve tables simultaneously
Orders and reservations need accurate, fast handling

secondary.name: Cafes
secondary.status: active vertical, closely related to restaurants
painPoints: Similar to restaurants — high call volume during peak hours, small staff

secondary.name: General Service Businesses
secondary.status: broad catch-all — companies not yet fitting a dedicated vertical page
painPoints: Any business losing revenue to missed or poorly handled inbound calls

productPillars.title: Trained on your business, not a generic script
productPillars.description: Every Calvo agent is custom-built around how your business actually operates — your services, your tone, your edge cases.

productPillars.title: Never misses a call
productPillars.description: Calvo answers instantly, every time, regardless of call volume or time of day.

productPillars.title: Sounds like your business, not a robot
productPillars.description: Natural, low-latency voice conversations that don't feel like an IVR menu.

productPillars.title: Full visibility
productPillars.description: Every call is logged, transcribed, and reportable through a dashboard your team actually checks.

howItWorks.step: Tell us how your business runs
howItWorks.description: We learn your services, hours, pricing logic, and the specific questions your callers actually ask.

howItWorks.step: We build and train your agent
howItWorks.description: Your Calvo agent is custom-configured — not a shared template — and tested against real call scenarios before it goes live.
Your agent handles inbound calls 24/7, escalating to a human exactly when it should.
Transcripts, call outcomes, and performance are all visible in your dashboard.

brandVoice.tone: confident, plain-spoken, no hype-speak, no exclamation points, no 'revolutionize/game-changing' language
vocabularyRules: Name things by what the business owner controls, not how the system works internally
No filler adjectives — specific over clever

colorPalette.accent: TBD — placeholder used forest green, not yet confirmed as final brand color

design.iconStatus: not final — current asset is a generic audio-waveform mark, flagged for redesign by a human designer before ship
